### Observed differences

- In the earlier window, activities A19, A22, A23, A24, A25, A10 and A08 appeared in about 10–27% of traces (e.g., A22 25%, A23 27%, A24 14%, A25 19%, A19 17.5%, A10 18.5%, A08 17.5%). In the later window these activities are absent or nearly absent (A19, A23, A24, A25, A10, A08 at 0%; A22 at 1%). [OCC002, OCC003, OCC004, OCC007, OCC008, OCC009, OCC010]
- In the later window, activities A20, A21, A30, A31 and A32 appear in essentially all traces (100% participation), whereas in the earlier window they were absent or nearly absent (A20 0.5%, A21 0.5%, A30–A32 0%). [OCC005, OCC006, OCC011, OCC012, OCC013]
- A04 increased from about 10% participation to about 72.5% participation, and its mean occurrences per trace rose from 0.11 to 0.79. [OCC001]
- A48 remains universal (100% in both windows), but its outgoing transitions changed: before it went to A22, A19, A23, A25, A24, A04, etc.; after it goes to A04 in about 70% of its outgoing transitions, and to A31, A21, A30, A32 and A20 in smaller shares. [DIR013]
- A04's successors changed: before it went to many activities including A52, A16 and A54; after it goes mainly to A20, A32, A31, A21, A30 and A33. [DIR001]
- The new activities A20, A21, A30, A31, A32 and A33 are executed together in the later window: co-occurrence between them is about 100%, with mixed order (e.g., A20 and A21 appear in both orders in about half each). [REL024, REL029, REL030, REL031, REL073, REL074, REL079]
- The old activities A19, A22–A25 no longer co-occur with the new ones; in the later window they are absent. [REL015, REL017, REL018, REL019, REL020]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports a major restructuring of the process: a set of activities that were present in a minority of traces in the earlier window (A19, A22–A25, A10, A08) are no longer observed, while a new set of activities (A20, A21, A30–A33) appears in essentially all traces in the later window, and A04 becomes a common intermediate step between A48 and the new activities. The number of qualifying items (130 vs. 1.06 expected by chance) is far beyond what an unchanged process would produce, and the pattern is consistent across occurrence, successor, position and co-occurrence indicators. The main limitation is that zero participation only means the activity was not observed, but the consistency across many indicators supports the change.

Other differences: A33 remains universal but its position shifts later (mean from 0.39 to 0.48), and A48's position shifts slightly earlier (mean from 0.33 to 0.28); A04's position also shifts earlier (mean from 0.54 to 0.33). These are consistent with the new segment after A04.
